MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The screw assortment fits my repeated purchases of fastener kits: having several sizes available helps with varied repairs, and imperial screws complement my recent metric kits.",
    "The leveling casters and pegboard fit the practical needs of a growing workshop: moving equipment, keeping it steady, and keeping tools accessible.",
    "The quick-setting glue offers a useful alternative to my epoxy and mounting tape for small repairs where those materials would be cumbersome."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The chain hook and knife-making steel assume specific projects that my drilling, cutting, and fastening purchases do not establish.",
    "The pH meter measures something I have no current reason to check, while multimeter leads require a compatible tool and a task I have not shown a need for.",
    "The protective sheets do not serve the same purpose as the mounting adhesives I have bought, and the three-inch bolts are relevant only when a job calls for that exact size."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying workshop supplies seems to have been taken as interest in almost any heavy-duty hardware, even when it serves an unrelated task.",
    "My measurement and adhesive purchases seem to have been treated too broadly: the quantity being measured and the purpose of the adhesive matter to me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated assortment purchases suggest I value having useful sizes on hand; a narrowly specified bolt needs a clearer immediate purpose.",
    "Accessories need to fit equipment I actually own, and specialized supplies need a connection to a project I am doing.",
    "Useful next choices can support my existing work through storage, stability, or quicker repairs without requiring me to start a new hobby."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my ongoing workshop and repair needs but sometimes stretched that interest into specialized tasks I have not shown a reason to pursue."
}
